input.oldString:
echo "Proprietary Software Scanner for Linux"
echo "======================================"
echo "Scanning installed packages and Flatpak apps for potentially proprietary software..."
echo ""

# Get list of foreign packages (not from official repos)
foreign_packages=$(pacman -Q --foreign | awk '{print $1}')

total_packages=$(pacman -Q | wc -l)
foreign_count=$(echo "$foreign_packages" | wc -l)
echo "Total installed packages: $total_packages"
echo "Packages from unofficial sources: $foreign_count"
echo ""

if [[ $foreign_count -gt 0 ]]; then
    proprietary_packages=()
    free_packages=()
    for pkg in $foreign_packages; do
        license=$(pacman -Qi "$pkg" 2>/dev/null | grep "Licenses" | awk '{print $3}' | tr -d ':')
        if [[ -z "$license" ]]; then
            license="Unknown"
        fi
        if is_free_license "$license"; then
            free_packages+=("$pkg ($license)")
        else
            proprietary_packages+=("$pkg ($license)")
        fi
    done

    if [[ ${#proprietary_packages[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
        echo "Potentially proprietary packages (from AUR or other sources):"
        for pkg in "${proprietary_packages[@]}"; do
            echo "- $pkg"
        done
        echo ""
    fi

    if [[ ${#free_packages[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
        echo "Free software packages (from AUR or other sources):"
        for pkg in "${free_packages[@]}"; do
            echo "- $pkg"
        done
        echo ""
    fi
else
    echo "No packages from unofficial sources found."
fi

echo ""

# Function to check if a license is free
is_free_license() {
    local license="$1"
    # List of common free licenses (case insensitive)
    free_licenses=("GPL" "LGPL" "MIT" "BSD" "Apache" "ISC" "CC0" "Public Domain" "WTFPL" "Zlib" "Boost")
    for free in "${free_licenses[@]}"; do
        if [[ "${license,,}" == *"${free,,}"* ]]; then
            return 0  # free
        fi
    done
    return 1  # proprietary
}
